package.title: Tempo.Blazor.WebPush
package.description: Optional VAPID Web Push sender for Tempo.Blazor notifications, implementing IWebPushSender on top of the WebPush library.

gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.WebPush
gettingStarted.overview: Optional VAPID Web Push sender for Tempo.Blazor notifications, implementing IWebPushSender on top of the WebPush library.

items.description: IWebPushSender that encrypts and delivers Web Push payloads to browser push services using VAPID (via the WebPush library). A 404/410 from the push service is surfaced as an expired TmWebPushResult so the caller can prune the dead subscription. Ships in the optional Tempo.Blazor.WebPush package so hosts opt into the WebPush dependency.

members.name: SendAsync
members.description: Encrypts and sends a payload to a single push subscription; returns a result that flags an expired subscription (HTTP 404/410) so the caller can prune it.

items.description: VAPID configuration for Web Push, bound from the "WebPush" configuration section. When PublicKey/PrivateKey are empty a host may generate an ephemeral key pair at startup.

members.name: PublicKey
members.description: VAPID public key (base64url, uncompressed P-256 point).

members.name: Subject
members.description: VAPID subject (a mailto: or origin URL).

members.name: IsConfigured
members.description: True when a usable VAPID key pair is configured.
